meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 cobrapy 载入基因组尺度代谢模型,跑 FBA、FVA、基因敲除与通量采样等计算,并给出通量数值、必需基因清单或培养基成分。
howto.when: 当你要求载入或导出 SBML 等代谢模型,或做 FBA、基因敲除等通量分析时触发。

say.text: 用 cobrapy 载入 textbook 模型,跑一次 FBA 看生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值与各反应通量

say.text: 对该模型做单基因敲除,列出生长低于 0.01 的必需基因
算出支持 50% 最大生长的最小培养基成分

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the Python cobrapy library to load genome-scale metabolic models and run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts and flux sampling, returning flux values, essential-gene lists or medium compositions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to handle genome-scale metabolic models (load or export SBML etc.), or to run FBA, gene knockouts and similar flux analyses.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model with cobrapy and run FBA to see the growth rate
Run single gene deletion on the model and list essential genes below 0.01 growth
say_en.note: Runs a single gene deletion screen

say_en.text: Compute the minimal medium supporting 50% of max growth
